scope: isolated synthetic DEV of five-action numerical one-step causal memory; not native Amalgam integration or owner first-use

prior_falsification.result: DEV_NO_GO; prior four-action XOR-invariant memory with 24-permutation exact Bayes control, cannot reuse seeds or claim gain

hypothesis: Source-blind archived numerical action/quadrant consequence banks with contradiction-gated phase-blind recall preserve A predictions and improve B late + A cold-return prequential 3-output MSE over strongest same-history conventional non-oracle control, without a private phase label.

fixed_source.generator: standalone synthetic public numerical 2D initial observations with stochastic real observed 2D next state and scalar reward, five distinct interventions; no original MetaHighwayEnv import
fixed_source.phase_laws: A/B/A: new state-dependent, non-XOR 5-action continuous response with fixed hidden action/region terms; null: A/A/A
fixed_source.public_initial_state: exogenous two-dimensional finite numeric public coordinates; full 2x5×4 action-quadrant coverage per 20-event cycle; seeded jitter independent of family
fixed_source.actions: public action=(episode_index % 5), quadrant=(floor(episode_index/5) % 4), same exogenous action/initial-state schedule for all learners; no private family/source phase in learner
fixed_source.noise: independent seeded Gaussian 0.02 standard deviation on each of dx,dy,reward; 3 actually witnessed noisy outcomes per public action

candidate.name: dual bounded action-conditioned, public-quadrant mean consequence banks, contradiction-gated archival mode switch
candidate.context: public quadrant of initial x/y (not latent or task labels), 5 action addresses, 3 scalar heads (dx,dy,reward)
candidate.forecast: prequential, means shrunk by one pseudo-witness zero anchor, before actual outcome; active bank only
candidate.novelty_gate: at least 100 prior source events; known active cell with count>=3; 3 consecutive residual MSE >0.15 triggers archived old bank freeze, second bank learns buffered 3 observed events
candidate.return_gate: both banks have >=3 observations at witnessed action+quadrant, and current competing bank pre-outcome MSE is lower by >0.08; 3 consecutive public outcome comparisons trigger return, buffering until selection
candidate.control_variations_frozen: no adjustable hyperparameters after source first-use; no post-result phase tuning or post-hoc query labels
candidate.retention: bank-0 byte-exact state at t=160 and t=320, exact checkpoint replay and duplicate/reordered witness rejection

controls: fully trained all-history per-action quadrant mean (same public evidence)
fully trained recent-80 per-action quadrant mean (same public evidence)
fully trained recent-40 per-action quadrant mean (same public evidence)
fully trained all-history per-action nearest-8 state-neighbor mean on raw numeric x,y
fully trained recent-80 per-action nearest-8 state-neighbor mean
fully trained all-history per-action three-feature ridge regression (intercept,x,y) for all three consequences

scoring.metric: mean prequential per-row ((delta-x error)^2+(delta-y error)^2+(reward error)^2)/3; lower better
scoring.primary_window: equal-weight pooled all 144 rows from novel_late+familiar_cold_return, per development seed
scoring.dev_feasibility: both development seeds: candidate pooled lower than each fully fitted non-oracle control by >=0.005, candidate separately novel_late and familiar_cold_return no worse than best respective conventional by 0.01, exact bank-0 byte-identical t160/t320, two banks formed, last 48 return predictions choose old bank >=0.80 fraction, null never spawns a second bank
scoring.negative: any missed margin, null false alarm, bank corruption or cold mismatch -> DEV_NO_GO; malformed source/data => SOURCE_INVALID, not eligible for retrial with same consumed seeds
scoring.science_classification: DEV_FEASIBLE_NOT_SCIENTIFIC if passing, else DEV_NO_GO; never SCIENTIFIC_PASS or external-world transfer

qualification.prior_fixture_gate: run deterministic source-free mechanical fixture tests on Ubuntu and Windows + mandatory full inherited native root regression, G29 derived-only commit, original model blobs unchanged before registering synthetic DEV first use
qualification.scoring_admission: separate single-use primary.admit committed only after fixture qualification with exact scientific source commit SHA; only marker-add source commit may score reserved DEV once; all other workflow jobs must hold first-use
qualification.science_replay: no rerun consumed DEV seeds; cross-platform check via independently audited archived reports or equal deterministic generated source, but do not run a second primary just for parity
qualification.dependency: Python 3.12 stdlib only, no network or simulator source, no paid APIs/third-party services, no self-hosted/private runner
qualification.provenance: separate source code/prereg, seed/split and original outcome log SHA, checkpoint SHA, tested candidate SHA/tree, final regression and resource use
